name: Bash
input:
cd [study]/runs/run-08/work && python3 -c "
import re
with open('_verify.cjs') as f:
    content = f.read()
content = content.replace(\"await page.waitForSelector('#task-dialog:not([open])');\", \"await page.waitForSelector('#task-dialog', { state: 'hidden' });\")
with open('_verify.cjs', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
"
grep -n "task-dialog', { state" _verify.cjs
